current_evidence: The council's application forms page (last updated 13 Feb 2025) links only this 'National and Local Requirements for Planning Applications (July 2013)' Word document and says 'We updated this list in July 2013'; planning.data.gov.uk also records this URL as NWLDC's local list, and no newer list or consultation was found. The downloaded document's cover reads 'Adopted July 2013'.

issues.detail: Grokbot does not capture the River Mease SAC report anywhere. This is the main requirement specific to NWL. Trigger: any proposal in the catchment area of the River Mease Special Area of Conservation in NWL District. It appears in every proforma for Householder (all three variants), Full, both Outline types, Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent, Conservation Area consent, LBC and LBC+advert. The report must show no adverse effect on the integrity of the SAC, alone or in combination with other proposals, and must cover water quality and water volumes.
issues.evidence: 'SAC report - Any proposal located in catchment area of the River Mease Special Area of Conservation (SAC) North West Leicestershire District.' (Appendix II item 31)

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment is filed under Householder only, the one type its own trigger excludes. It is missing from every type the document applies it to: Full, Outline (some and all matters reserved), Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent, Listed Building Consent and LBC+advert. Trigger: all non-householder applications in Coal Mining Referral Areas. The explanation adds that this affects applications submitted to NW Leicestershire.
issues.evidence: 'To accompany all applications, except for householder applications, located in Coal Mining Referral Areas' (Full, Outline, LBC proformas); 'This affects applications submitted to NW Leicestershire and Leicestershire County Council'

issues.detail: The Householder sheet holds no valid requirement: its only row (Coal Mining) excludes householders. The Householder proforma's actual local requirements are: existing and proposed elevations, floor plans, and site sections/finished floor and site levels (as necessary, 1:50 or 1:100); a roof plan where the roof is not a simple single, dual or mono pitch; the EA standing-advice flood form for proposals in Flood Zones 2 or 3; and the River Mease SAC report. The Householder + CA demolition and Householder + LBC proformas add a Heritage Statement (all), photographs/photomontages (all) and a structural survey (where demolition is justified by structural condition). The LBC variant also requires cross-section details of windows and doors.
issues.evidence: Section 3 'Householder application for planning permission for works or extension to a dwelling' - LOCAL REQUIREMENTS

issues.detail: Outline is marked '(none)', but the document has two Outline proformas with almost the same local list as Full: affordable housing statement, air quality, Building for Life 12, biodiversity/protected species, economic statement, ES, town centre uses (retail/sequential), FRA, heritage statement, land contamination, lighting, noise, open space, planning obligations/Heads of Terms, SCI, telecoms supplementary information, transport assessment, travel plan, ventilation/extraction, SAC report, aviation impact, birdstrike and coal mining. Elevations, floor plans, sections and roof plan are needed only if appearance, scale, layout or landscaping is not reserved.
issues.evidence: 'Application for Outline Planning Permission with some matters reserved' / 'with all matters reserved' - LOCAL REQUIREMENTS

issues.detail: Reserved matters is marked '(none)', but its proforma requires existing and proposed elevations, floor plans, site sections/finished floor and site levels (as necessary, 1:50 or 1:100), a roof plan for non-simple roofs, and an Environmental Statement where EIA applies.
issues.evidence: 'Application for Approval of Reserved Matters following outline approval' - LOCAL REQUIREMENTS

issues.detail: Advertisement consent is marked '(none)', but its proforma requires: existing and proposed elevations; sections showing advert projection and depth; a lighting assessment when illuminated advertisements are proposed; and photographs/photomontages when hoardings are proposed. Grokbot instead files 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' under Full planning.
issues.evidence: 'Application for Advertisement consent' - 'Lighting assessment: When illuminated advertisements are proposed'; 'Photographs and Photomontages: When hoardings are proposed'

issues.detail: Demolition in a conservation area is marked '(none)', but the Conservation Area consent proforma requires: a Heritage Statement (all applications); photographs/photomontages of the whole building and its setting (all applications); a structural survey when demolition is justified by structural condition; and the River Mease SAC report.
issues.evidence: 'Conservation Area consent for demolition in a Conservation Area' - LOCAL REQUIREMENTS

issues.detail: The Listed building consent sheet has only 'Schedule of works' and 'Structural Survey', both taken from guidance text inside the Heritage Statement explanation. It misses the proforma's actual items: Heritage Statement (all applications); photographs/photomontages (all); existing and proposed elevations, floor plans and sections; roof plan; cross-section details of proposed windows and doors (1:50 or 1:20); River Mease SAC report; and Coal Mining Risk Assessment. The structural survey trigger should be 'when the justification for demolition is based on structural condition / soundness'. Grokbot's 'may be required in support of an application for LBC' is wrong.
issues.evidence: 'Listed Building consent for alterations, extension or demolition of a listed Building' - LOCAL REQUIREMENTS

issues.detail: Photographs/Photomontages are filed under Full planning as 'All applications', but the plain Full planning proforma has no photograph requirement. Photos are required for: Planning permission with CA consent or LBC (all); Householder with CA/LBC (all); CA consent and LBC (all); Planning permission with advert consent (if hoardings); advert consent (hoardings); and prior notification of demolition (all, to record the building). The 'All applications' excerpt comes from the Planning permission + CA consent table.
issues.evidence: 'Photos/Photomontages - All applications' appears only in the combined CA/LBC proformas; Full planning LOCAL REQUIREMENTS has no photographs row

issues.detail: Structural Survey is filed only under Listed building consent. The document also requires it under Full planning (barn conversions, demolition and rebuild, or where demolition is justified by structural condition), Planning permission with CA consent or LBC, Planning permission with advert consent (barn conversions or demolition and rebuild), CA consent, and Householder with CA/LBC. Grokbot's tab_items carry the general trigger ('substantial demolition... barn conversion'), but it never reaches the app type sheets.
issues.evidence: Full planning: 'Structural Survey - Barn conversions or demolition and rebuild or when the justification for demolition is based on structural condition / soundness'

issues.detail: Lawful development cert, Variation of condition s73, Non-material amendment and Discharge of conditions are all marked '(none)', but the document gives each local items. LDC (existing): an existing site survey plan (all applications), plus existing elevations and floor plans where alterations or split uses are involved. LDC (proposed): elevations, floor plans and sections. S73 and NMA: any original plan, statement or report that needs revising where the change affects the original details or circumstances have materially changed. Discharge: the information required by the condition. The extension-of-time proforma has a similar 'updated report' rule.
issues.evidence: LDC existing: 'Existing site survey plan (e.g. at a scale of 1:50 or 1:100) - All applications'; Discharge: 'Information required by condition'

issues.detail: Prior notification requirements are missing. For telecoms code operators, every notification needs the Supplementary Information Template (Annex F of the Code of Best Practice on Mobile Phone Network Development). For prior notification of demolition, every application needs photographs/photomontages to record the building to be demolished. Grokbot puts telecoms information only under Full planning and marks prior approval as '(none)'. The agricultural prior notifications and hedgerow notices correctly have no local items.
issues.evidence: 'Supplementary Information Template (as set out in Annex F...) - All notifications'; 'Photographs/Photomontages - All applications - to record development proposed to be demolished'

issues.detail: Building for Life 12 assessment is missing. Trigger: all major residential developments in Charnwood, Leicester City and North West Leicestershire. It is listed under Full, both Outline types and Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent, and may form part of the DAS.
issues.evidence: 'Building for life 12 assessment - All major residential developments in Charnwood, Leicester City and North West Leicestershire areas.'

issues.detail: Land Contamination Assessment is missing. Trigger: where contamination is known or suspected. It applies to Full, Outline and Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent.
issues.evidence: 'Land Contamination assessment - Where contamination is known or suspected.'

issues.detail: Noise Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: noise-sensitive development close to existing sources of noise, or a proposal that will generate significant noise. It applies to Full, Outline and Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent and must be prepared by a qualified acoustician.
issues.evidence: 'Noise impact assessment - Where noise sensitive developments are close to existing sources of noise or the proposal will generate significant noise levels.'

issues.detail: Open Space Assessment is missing. Trigger: all major residential developments and any application that would lose open space. It applies to Full, Outline and Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent and may be included in the DAS.
issues.evidence: 'Open Space assessment - All major residential developments and applications where there would be a loss of open space.'

issues.detail: Aviation Impact Assessment is missing from app_type_rows. Trigger: all wind turbine applications within 30 km of East Midlands Airport. It applies to Full, Outline and Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent and must include details of pre-application discussions with the Airport. In tab_items it appears only as a bare heading ('Aviation Impact Assessment:') stuck to the Rutland SPA row.
issues.evidence: 'Aviation Impact Assessment: For all Wind Turbine applications located within 30 km of East Midlands Airport'

issues.detail: Birdstrike Assessment is missing. Trigger: developments within 13 km of East Midlands Airport that are likely to attract birds. Examples are waste handling or disposal facilities, new or altered water bodies and wetlands, nature reserves, sewage works and mineral extraction. It applies to Full, Outline and Planning permission with CA/LBC/advert consent. Grokbot uses a sentence from this item as the trigger for an unrelated 'Pre-application advice' row.
issues.evidence: 'Birdstrike Assessments - Developments within 13km of East Midlands Airport that are likely to attract birds.'

issues.detail: Two plan requirements appear only as scale notes in tab_items and are absent from app_type_rows. Roof Plan: where the roof is not a simple single, dual or mono pitch (Householder, Full, Outline if not reserved, Reserved matters, LBC and the combined types). Cross-section detail of proposed windows and doors: LBC, Householder + LBC, Planning permission + LBC and LBC + advert (1:50 or 1:20).
issues.evidence: 'Roof Plan - Where the roof design is not simple single dual or mono pitches'; 'X-section detail of proposed windows and doors'

issues.detail: The 'Habitats Regulations Assessment information / SPA mitigation' row under Full planning uses the Rutland Water SPA trigger. That requirement applies only to proposals within Rutland County Council's area, so it is irrelevant to NWL. The trigger text then runs into the householder protected-species advice. The habitats requirement that applies in NWL is the River Mease SAC report, which Grokbot omits.
issues.evidence: 'Rutland Water Special Protection Area (SPA) report - Any proposal located in the Rutland Water Special Protection Area (SPA) Rutland County Council'; 'within the administrative area of Rutland County Council'

issues.detail: Policy-driven tab_items have the 'Rutland Water Special Protection Area (SPA) report Any proposal located in the Rutland Water SPA Rutland County Council' table row stuck to the front of other entries (Biodiversity survey, Aviation Impact Assessment, Listed Building note, Coal Mining Risk Assessment). In the document this row is simply followed by the next item in each proforma. This artefact is repeated four times and makes each item read like an SPA requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Rutland Water Special Protection Area (SPA) report ... Rutland County Council Aviation Impact Assessment:'

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment trigger under Full planning is the Householder proforma's text: in Flood Zones 2 or 3 a standard form is completed 'to negate the need for' an FRA. For Full and Outline the document requires an FRA within main river bye-law distance, in Flood Zones 2 and 3, or for sites over 1 hectare in Flood Zone 1. The explanation adds non-minor development in a critical drainage area. Grokbot's excerpt says the reverse, that no FRA is needed.
issues.evidence: Full planning: 'Where the development is proposed within Main river bye-law distance or where the development is within flood zones 2 & 3 or the site is greater than 1 hectare within Flood Zone 1'

issues.detail: Several app_type trigger excerpts describe a different item from the requirement named. Telecommunications supplementary information has the Town Centre Uses text. Pre-application advice has a birdstrike sentence. Planning Statement has the EIA text. Economic statement runs into EIA and misses its trigger, 'Where viability is an issue'. Photographs runs into the planning obligations row. Planning Obligations uses Section 2 commentary ('conditions will be used in preference') instead of its trigger: development that triggers contributions in DPDs, or a developer who volunteers contributions or seeks an exception. Highways/access details uses the location-plan red-line text.
issues.evidence: Telecoms excerpt: 'Radiation Protection (ICNIRP). 36 Town Centre Uses -Evidence to accompany applications...'

issues.detail: Many other excerpts start mid-sentence with stray words and paragraph numbers from the appendix, or give NPPF commentary instead of the proforma threshold. Air Quality should read 'inside or adjacent to an AQMA and likely to affect or be affected by air quality'. Heritage Statement ('Agency. 23...') should read 'all major applications and any site with an entry in the Leicestershire and Rutland HER', or all applications for CA/LBC types. Design and Access Statement gives the Householder '100 sq m in a conservation area' threshold, not Full's 'major development; or in a CA, one or more dwellings or 100 sq m'. Town Centre Uses ('(ICNIRP). 36') omits the retail, leisure, office, cultural and tourist uses it covers. Other affected rows are Transport Assessment ('uses. 37'), Travel Plan ('Council 38'), Tree survey ('document. 56'), Geotechnical ('provider. 47'), Lighting (starts 'countryside,'), Block plan (national table rows merged) and Viability Assessment (missing the context that it is needed when seeking an exception to affordable housing policy).
issues.evidence: Air Quality excerpt: 'provide an Air Quality Assessment as part of the planning application. 16 Biodiversity Survey and Report Where...'

issues.detail: Grokbot files several items under Full planning that come from the document's 'Explanation of other terms, assessments and report' glossary (items 41-57). None of them appears in any application-type proforma: Drainage Strategy/SuDS, Foul Sewage/Utilities Statement, Geotechnical/ground investigation, Parking provision, Planning Statement, Tree Survey/Arboricultural Impact, Refuse storage and recycling, and Highways/access details. Some glossary entries say 'will be required' (refuse storage) or refer to the 1APP form (trees), but they are guidance, not validation items. 'Pre-application advice' is also not a requirement: Section 2 only invites applicants to seek it.
issues.evidence: 'Explanation of other terms, assessments and report' (items 41-57); Section 2: 'Applicants are invited to have pre-application consultation'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are reference links, boilerplate or navigation fragments, not requirements: 'Non-statutory guidance for site waste management plans (April 2008, PDF 150 KB): 3.', 'Toolkits available to assist production of a SWMP (PDF 40 KB): 4.', 'Cost benefit analysis for the introduction of SWMPs... (PDF 700 KB): 5.', 'Questions and answers (PDF 15 KB): 54 Summaries...', and 'If submitted electronically paper copies are not required.' The last is from the national standard-form explanation. The drawing-standards items also carry 'Back to index page' navigation text and section numbers.
issues.evidence: Appendix II item 53 'Site Waste Management Plan' further-information links; item 2 'Standard application form'

issues.detail: Three Policy-section tab_items are background text, not applicant requirements: the SPA definition; the sentence on the County Council's duty to prepare an Appropriate Assessment, which concerns Rutland; and Table 2's designated-site list, taken out of context. Table 2 is the trigger list for an Ecological/Geological Survey and Assessment where a proposal is likely to affect those sites, and that requirement is not stated.
issues.evidence: 'Special Protection Areas (SPAs) are strictly protected sites designated under the EC Habitats Directive...'; 'TABLE 2 ... Criteria (Trigger List) for When a Survey and Assessment are Required'

issues.detail: Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment is filed as a Full planning requirement, but the document says it is not one.
issues.evidence: '57 Visual Impact Assessment / Landscape Character Assessment - This is not a requirement but can be produced as a separate assessment or part of the Design and Access Statement.'

issues.detail: Several rows duplicate each other. 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' and 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' both carry the table-of-contents fragment '...Protected Species Survey and Report 57', and the document has no biodiversity questionnaire. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' both use the same foul-drainage sentence. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is the isolux sentence from the Lighting Assessment explanation, so it repeats the Lighting row. The Telecoms and Retail/Town Centre rows have identical excerpts.
issues.evidence: Contents page: '57 III Biodiversity Survey and Report / Ecological Survey / Protected Species Survey and Report'

issues.detail: Grokbot records this as a council-specific list ('Joint / shared list' blank; 'council-specific (no shared list identified)'). It is actually a joint list for the Leicestershire and Rutland authorities. This explains why Grokbot picked up Rutland-only items (Rutland Water SPA) and missed the area-specific scoping (River Mease SAC and Coal Mining for NWL; Building for Life 12 for Charnwood, Leicester City and NWL).
issues.evidence: Cover: 'For Leicestershire and Rutland Local Authorities'; para 3: 'a group of the Leicestershire and Rutland Planning Authorities has sought through this document to set down a consistent and proportionate approach'

issues.detail: The list is still the council's current published list but is over 13 years old, so users should be warned. It cites NPPF 2012 paragraph numbers and ODPM Circular 06/2005. It includes Conservation Area Consent (abolished in 2013), A3/A4/A5 use classes (revoked in 2020) and Site Waste Management Plan Regulations (revoked in 2013). Its own text says lists must be re-published every two years. Grokbot's 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag is correct, but it carries obsolete items such as the SWMP references without comment.
issues.evidence: Para 1: 'revisions to legislation were made requiring local authorities to re-publish their lists every two years'; cover 'Adopted July 2013'

summary: Grokbot links to and dates the right document (the joint Leicestershire and Rutland list, adopted July 2013, still current for NWL), but its extraction is poor. It misses the River Mease SAC report, which is specific to NWL, along with Building for Life 12, land contamination, noise, open space, aviation and birdstrike. It files Coal Mining only under Householder, the one type it excludes, and leaves Outline, Reserved matters, Advertisement, CA demolition and LDC empty even though each has its own proforma. Many of its Full planning rows are glossary items, boilerplate or misattributed excerpts, including a Rutland-only SPA requirement and a Householder FRA trigger that does not apply to Full planning.
